messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I have been racking my brain all freaking day and I can not come up with anything.

output.original_text: I have been racking my brain all freaking day and I can not come up with anything.
output.joy: I’ve been thinking so hard all day, and I just can’t seem to find anything amazing!
output.sadness: I’ve been struggling all day trying to think of something, but nothing seems to click.
output.fear: I’ve been racking my brain all day, and I’m really worried I can’t figure this out.
output.anger: I’ve been racking my brain all freaking day and I’m so frustrated that I can’t come up with anything!
output.surprise: I can’t believe I’ve been racking my brain all day and still can’t come up with anything!
output.disgust: I’ve been racking my brain all day, and it’s just so frustrating that I can't produce a single good idea.
